name: Celestial Origami Aviary
description: A flock of origami birds folded from star‑maps, wings shimmering with constellations, soaring in a twilight sky.
prompt: A sky filled with dozens of origami birds — cranes, swallows — each crafted from paper printed with intricate star charts. Their wings catch the fading sunlight, revealing constellations. Soft clouds, pastel gradient sky. Crisp detail, 8K.
caption: Paper birds that carry the night sky on their wings. 🕊️🌟 #CelestialOrigamiAviary
